description: This file defines the Renderer class responsible for rendering elements within a scene, including methods for obtaining visible and renderable elements, and cleanup logic.

classes.name: Renderer
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering scene elements, managing visible elements, and cleanup.

methods.name: getRenderableElements
methods.description: Returns a memoized function that computes visible and renderable elements based on scene state and viewport parameters.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, cancels throttled static scene rendering, and clears cached renderable elements.
